clauses.clause: Opus answers three questions per level: glitches (list), stunning (verdict + missing), **boring / harmless / babysitting** (list). Any "harmless" or "babysitting" finding blocks GO.
clauses.note: Blocking babysitting counterexample: low L3 records144 matching waiting-for-squad HUD samples from tick9708 to19976,171.133333seconds; final corgi separation297.816993m. Route cannot finish, no objective skips. High L3 completion does not erase this trial. Ten level files answer glitches, scene quality/missing detail, and boring/harmless/babysitting within their stated observed scope. Low L10 also strands the following corgi1200.4576m behind; static geometry is clear, nav blocked. No mortal harmlessness conclusion is inferred from protected player damage.
